d:
Before planes could take off, someone had to build the ground beneath them. Marshlands. Creeks. A basalt hill.
What looked impossible became the foundation of Navi Mumbai International Airport, thanks to the vision, grit and ingenuity of an engineering team led by Ramlingeshwar Rao.
Their work may stay beneath the surface, but every takeoff begins with it.
In Partnership with Adani Airports
